title: General requirements for loans and extensions of credit.
partHeading: PART III. LOANS AND EXTENSIONS OF CREDIT
bodyText:
PART III. LOANS AND EXTENSIONS OF CREDIT

A financial services loan company shall make loans and extensions of credit that are consistent with prudent lending practices, and in compliance with all applicable federal and state laws.
crossReferences: Credit sale contracts, finance charges on, see §476-28.
Secured transactions, Uniform Commercial Code, see §490:9-203.
